description: Mandatory deterministic fixture (CLAUDE.md, docs/07 §3). Canonical state hashes for the fixed seed + DEFAULT_CONFIG + the fixed command log below (one command of every intervention kind, Milestone 9). Intentional engine behavior changes require an ENGINE_VERSION bump, regenerated hashes (pnpm headless --seed 0xE0A12026 --ticks 10000 --checkpoints 0,1,10,100,1000,10000 --fixture-commands) and a CHANGELOG entry. Engine 0.7.0 regenerated every hash: the canonical stream gained the founder region and the command log, event payloads became signed 32-bit words, the config gained the interventions section, and the fixture now RUNS the command log — the trajectory legitimately diverges from 0.6.0 once the first command applies at tick 50 (by tick 10000: population 4381 vs 4364, 26 drowning deaths from the flooded LOWER_TERRAIN stroke, a meteor crater at the founder centre). Tick 0 and 1 differ from 0.6.0 only through the hash-stream and config changes; the organism trajectory is identical until the first command applies. Engine 0.8.0 regenerated every hash again, for two intentional authoritative changes (ADR 0025): the expected-gain food-target rule replaced the categorical carcass gate (docs/04 §20 as amended), and the plant capacities were calibrated to 0.6x the v0.1 hypothesis (docs/08 §5 as amended, closing L11). The tick-0 hash moves through the config digest alone; the trajectory diverges once feeding decisions begin. The 0.8.0 calibration also moves carcass decay 20 -> 48 (docs/08 §15 as amended). By tick 10000 the leaner, scavenging world holds population 1003 (was 4381), 1382 live carcasses under the 4096 cap (was pinned at it), and has eaten 511.4k meat units (was 0 on the pre-policy reference world). Engine 0.9.0 (M14, docs/11 §M14) regenerated every hash for one intentional authoritative change: organisms carry a 27-gene morphological genome, inherited and mutated like the ecological one and hashed with it, so the canonical stream is longer and the PRNG stream gains 27 classification draws per birth. Tick 0 moves through the config digest and the founder bodies; the trajectory diverges from the first birth, because morphological mutation consumes draws that ecological and brain mutation used to consume. Morphology has no physical consequence yet — that is M15 — so the ecological trajectory is the same rules on a different random stream. Engine 0.10.0 (M15, docs/11 §M15, ADR 0029) regenerated every hash for one intentional authoritative change: the developed body now has physical consequence. A centralized PhysicalPhenotype turns morphology into sixteen multipliers on mass, energy storage, basal upkeep, growth cost, top speed, acceleration, turn rate, water performance, armor, attack, bite size, vision range and arc, thermal tolerance, contact extent and offspring construction cost. The founder body is exactly neutral in all sixteen, so tick 0 moves only through the config digest — the new organism.physicalMorphology block — and the founder population's physics is bit-for-bit the ecology Milestones 0–13 calibrated. The trajectory diverges from the first birth, when a mutated body first weighs, moves, eats and costs something different from its parent's. By tick 10000 the fixture world holds population 1841 with 555.3k meat units eaten, 5301 births and 3460 deaths. Only the tick-10000 checkpoint moved from the first 0.10.0 regeneration: flooring offspringCostFactorQ at Q (a birth must never create energy) changes nothing until a parent lighter than the founder reproduces, which on this seed happens after tick 1000. Engine 0.11.0 (M16, docs/11 §M16, ADR 0030) regenerated every hash for one intentional authoritative change on four counts: the neural topology genome is inherited state and joins the canonical stream; authoritative neural state (memory registers and carried hidden activations) joins it as its own section; the weight block grew 400 -> 576 for the recurrent and memory blocks; and structural mutation adds draws at every birth. Tick 0 moves through the config digest, the wider genome and the founder's topology; the trajectory diverges from the first birth. The founder's brain costs exactly zero upkeep by construction, so M16 does not re-tune the calibrated ecology by existing — but brain upkeep is a real drain on any lineage that grows one, and by tick 10000 the fixture world holds population 960 with 538.3k meat units eaten, 4211 births and 3251 deaths.
